1934, October
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO, 5.
Page 246 Cont.
Oct. 13 Mrs. Mary Casaceli - 41 - had two operations - has four young boys ... kidney etc, trouble.
Mrs. Mabel Albrecht - 27 - nervous break-down - fears ..... fears
Mrs. Mary McGillivary - baptist - 48 - had operation very serious last Dec. - now threatened again -
15 Mary Gettings of Appleton, Wis. - blind in one eye - other threaten- ed - alone - Enrolled.
Mrs. Cha's Willgues ... 50 (?) to healer - very nerveous ..
Blank Page
Page 247 Page 248 Oct. Richard Burk - 14 - operation in August for abcess on brain - im- proved very little - yesterday operated on again - improved To-day ... prayers .... .
Mrs. Ann McCarthy - 42 - tuomer in uterus 5-6 yrs. fearful pains ... Irene Rodden - 42 - degenerative Arthritis, one leg 6 inches short.
Ralph Wahler - 18 - keeping company with non Catholic & undesirable ... has become hardened towards parents.
John Dordell - 34 - fallen away ...
Mrs. Rose Reddin - 41 - gall-stones ... husband drinking abusing child'n Joseph Sliwmski - 41 - sinus -trying to sell - save ...
Page 249 Page 250 Oct.
Blank Page
Susiebell, Mrs. Hessiner - 34 - goiter
Meyers Family of 6 wish to thank God for many blessings. Oldest son, a cripple was brought hither about a year ago. Enrolled in Ser. Mass As. Parents were presbiterian & Episcop'n. The boy is manifest- ly improved ... and all have joined Church. Deo Gr.
